query:
SELECT id as "id!: i32", 
target_account_id as "target_account_id!: String", 
created_by_account_id as "created_by_account_id!: Option < String >", 
starts_at as "starts_at!: UtcDateTime", 
ends_at as "ends_at!: UtcDateTime", 
created_at as "created_at!: UtcDateTime" FROM weekly_score_picks WHERE (NOT $1::boolean OR id = $2::int4) AND (NOT $3::boolean OR id = ANY(CAST($4 as int4[])) ) AND (NOT $5::boolean OR id <> ALL(CAST($6 as int4[])) ) AND (NOT $7::boolean OR target_account_id = $8::varchar) AND (NOT $9::boolean OR created_by_account_id = $10::varchar) AND ($11::boolean IS NULL OR (($11::boolean AND created_by_account_id IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $11::boolean AND created_by_account_id IS NULL))) AND (NOT $12::boolean OR starts_at = $13::timestamptz) AND (NOT $14::boolean OR ends_at = $15::timestamptz) AND (NOT $16::boolean OR created_at = $17::timestamptz) ORDER BY 
      (CASE ($18 = 'Id' AND NOT $19) WHEN true THEN id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($18 = 'Id' AND $19) WHEN true THEN id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($18 = 'TargetAccountId' AND NOT $19) WHEN true THEN target_account_id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($18 = 'TargetAccountId' AND $19) WHEN true THEN target_account_id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($18 = 'CreatedByAccountId' AND NOT $19) WHEN true THEN created_by_account_id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($18 = 'CreatedByAccountId' AND $19) WHEN true THEN created_by_account_id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($18 = 'StartsAt' AND NOT $19) WHEN true THEN starts_at ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($18 = 'StartsAt' AND $19) WHEN true THEN starts_at ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($18 = 'EndsAt' AND NOT $19) WHEN true THEN ends_at ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($18 = 'EndsAt' AND $19) WHEN true THEN ends_at ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($18 = 'CreatedAt' AND NOT $19) WHEN true THEN created_at ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($18 = 'CreatedAt' AND $19) WHEN true THEN created_at ELSE NULL END) DESC
     LIMIT $20 OFFSET $21 FOR UPDATE
